blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines – The National Capital Region Police Office (NCRPO) will be placed on full alert starting Saturday midnight as police prepare for rallies in Metro Manila condemning corruption and marking the 54th anniversary of the declaration of Martial Law on Sept. 21. In a press briefing in Camp Crame on Thursday, Philippine National Police (PNP) public information chief Col. Allen Rae Co announced the heightened security posture. He did not specify when the full alert status would be lifted. The full alert status is the PNP’s highest operational readiness and security deployment, suspending all leaves for officers and requiring all […]...
